name: PlenOctree Compression with Modified Training and Sparsity
definition: A method to reduce the storage size of PlenOctree models (which store density σ and Spherical Harmonics coefficients k) by modifying the NeRF-SH training loss, optimizing sparsity, and compressing the resulting voxelized point cloud attributes.
summary: Sparse PlenOctree Training reduces storage by modifying NeRF-SH training with Cauchy loss and total variation regularization to optimize sparsity before compressing voxelized attributes.
